reached_sql:
WITH bucket_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        CASE WHEN ss_quantity BETWEEN 1 AND 20 THEN 'bucket1' 
             WHEN ss_quantity BETWEEN 21 AND 40 THEN 'bucket2' 
             WHEN ss_quantity BETWEEN 41 AND 60 THEN 'bucket3' 
             WHEN ss_quantity BETWEEN 61 AND 80 THEN 'bucket4' 
             WHEN ss_quantity BETWEEN 81 AND 100 THEN 'bucket5' END AS bucket,
        COUNT(*) AS count
    FROM store_sales
),
bucket_averages AS (
    SELECT 
        CASE WHEN ss_quantity BETWEEN 1 AND 20 THEN 'bucket1' 
             WHEN ss_quantity BETWEEN 21 AND 40 THEN 'bucket2' 
             WHEN ss_quantity BETWEEN 41 AND 60 THEN 'bucket3' 
             WHEN ss_quantity BETWEEN 61 AND 80 THEN 'bucket4' 
             WHEN ss_quantity BETWEEN 81 AND 100 THEN 'bucket5' END AS bucket,
        AVG(ss_ext_tax) AS avg_ext_tax,
        AVG(ss_net_paid_inc_tax) AS avg_net_paid_inc_tax
    FROM store_sales
    GROUP BY bucket
)
SELECT 
    COALESCE(bc.count > 1071, FALSE) * ba.avg_ext_tax + (NOT COALESCE(bc.count > 1071, FALSE)) * ba.avg_net_paid_inc_tax AS bucket1,
    COALESCE(bc.count > 39161, FALSE) * ba.avg_ext_tax + (NOT COALESCE(bc.count > 39161, FALSE)) * ba.avg_net_paid_inc_tax AS bucket2,
    COALESCE(bc.count > 29434, FALSE) * ba.avg_ext_tax + (NOT COALESCE(bc.count > 29434, FALSE)) * ba.avg_net_paid_inc_tax AS bucket3,
    COALESCE(bc.count > 6568, FALSE) * ba.avg_ext_tax + (NOT COALESCE(bc.count > 6568, FALSE)) * ba.avg_net_paid_inc_tax AS bucket4,
    COALESCE(bc.count > 21216, FALSE) * ba.avg_ext_tax + (NOT COALESCE(bc.count > 21216, FALSE)) * ba.avg_net_paid_inc_tax AS bucket5
FROM bucket_counts bc
JOIN bucket_averages ba ON bc.bucket = ba.bucket
WHERE reason.r_reason_sk = 1
